carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
sarvadā sarvasaukhyāḍhyo jāyate divi ceha ca .. 6.29.220 ..
nāsti bhargasamo devo nāsti gaṃgāsamā nadī ..
nāsti hiṃsāsamaṃ pāpaṃ nāsti dharmo dayāparaḥ .. 221 ..
athāhamabruvaṃ taṃ ca tacchrutvā tasya jalpitam ..
ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paralokabhayāturaḥ .. 222 ..
5.29.d:
एतत्ते परमं गुह्यं मया विप्र प्रकीर्तितम् ..
नास्तिकाय न दातव्यं भक्तिहीनाय नैव च .. 216 ..
तथान्यदपि वक्ष्यामि हितबुद्ध्या द्विजोत्तम ..
मम वाक्यं कुरुष्वाद्य यदीच्छसि परां गतिम्.. 217 ..
अहिंसा परमो धर्मः सर्ववेदे प्रकीर्तितः ..
ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण तस्मात्सर्पवधं त्यज .. 218..
अहिंसकानि भूतानि यो हिनस्ति सुनिर्दयः ..
स याति नरकं घोरं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 219 ..
चराचराणां भूतानामभयं यः प्रयच्छति ..
सर्वदा सर्वसौख्याढ्यो जायते दिवि चेह च .. 6.29.220 ..
नास्ति भर्गसमो देवो नास्ति गंगासमा नदी ..
नास्ति हिंसासमं पापं नास्ति धर्मो दयापरः .. 221 ..
अथाहमब्रुवं तं च तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य जल्पितम् ..
अहिंसालक्षणं धर्मं परलोकभयातुरः .. 222 ..
5.29.m:
This supreme secret has been declared to you by me, O brahmin; / it must not be given to an atheist, nor ever to one devoid of devotion.
Likewise, I shall say something else out of concern for your welfare, O best of brahmins; / heed my word today if you desire the supreme state:
Non-violence is proclaimed in all the Vedas as the supreme virtue, / especially for a brahmin; therefore, give up the slaughter of snakes.
He who cruelly harms harmless living beings / goes to a terrible hell until the dissolution of all created things.
He who grants fearlessness to mobile and immobile beings / is constantly endowed with all happiness, both in heaven and here on earth.
There is no god equal to Bharga; there is no river equal to the Gaṅgā; / there is no sin equal to violence; there is no duty higher than compassion.
Then, having heard what he had said about the virtue characterized by non-violence, / I, anxious with fear of the next world, said to him:

5.29.s:
manyate vṛddhalokānāmetadvākyaṃ śrutaṃ mayā ..
bhūpaterneva doṣaḥ syādvane vyāpāditairmṛgaiḥ .. 223 .
pravadaṃti tathā vaidyā vaidyaśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ ..
bhavaṃti puṣṭisaṃyukā māṃsādāścirajīvinaḥ .. 224 ..
tadatra viṣaye brūhi paraṃ niḥśreyasaṃ vacaḥ ..
sarvaṃ kartāsmyasaṃdigdhaṃ tava vaktrādvinirgatam .. 225 ..
atha māṃ sa punaḥ prāha vada maivaṃ dvijottama ..
matametada sādhūnāṃ pāpānāṃ māṃsagṛddhinām .. 226 ..
aho śocyatamā loke pāpātmānaḥ sunirdayāḥ ..
sarvadoṣākaraṃ māṃsaṃ mūḍhāḥ svādaṃti ye narāḥ .. ... 227 ..
na māṃsamāyuṣo heturārogyasya balasya vā ..
sarvametadasatyaṃ syācchraṇuṣvādya nidarśanam .. 228 ..
māṃsāśino'pi dṛśyaṃte rogārtā durbalāstathā ..
svalpāyuṣaśca matvaivaṃ māṃsaṃ varjaya dūrataḥ .. 229 ..
5.29.d:
मन्यते वृद्धलोकानामेतद्वाक्यं श्रुतं मया ..
भूपतेर्नेव दोषः स्याद्वने व्यापादितैर्मृगैः .. 223 .
प्रवदंति तथा वैद्या वैद्यशास्त्रविचक्षणाः ..
भवंति पुष्टिसंयुका मांसादाश्चिरजीविनः .. 224 ..
तदत्र विषये ब्रूहि परं निःश्रेयसं वचः ..
सर्वं कर्तास्म्यसंदिग्धं तव वक्त्राद्विनिर्गतम् .. 225 ..
अथ मां स पुनः प्राह वद मैवं द्विजोत्तम ..
मतमेतद साधूनां पापानां मांसगृद्धिनाम् .. 226 ..
अहो शोच्यतमा लोके पापात्मानः सुनिर्दयाः ..
सर्वदोषाकरं मांसं मूढाः स्वादंति ये नराः .. ... 227 ..
न मांसमायुषो हेतुरारोग्यस्य बलस्य वा ..
सर्वमेतदसत्यं स्याच्छ्रणुष्वाद्य निदर्शनम् .. 228 ..
मांसाशिनोऽपि दृश्यंते रोगार्ता दुर्बलास्तथा ..
स्वल्पायुषश्च मत्वैवं मांसं वर्जय दूरतः .. 229 ..
5.29.m:
‘This statement of the elders has been heard and acknowledged by me: / "No guilt attaches to a king on account of deer killed in the forest."
Likewise, physicians skilled in the science of medicine proclaim: / "Those who eat meat become well-nourished and live long."
Therefore, speak words that bring the highest good regarding this matter; / whatever comes from your mouth, I will certainly carry it out.’
Then he said to me again: ‘Do not speak thus, O best of brahmins! / This is the opinion of wicked, sinful men who crave meat.
Ah, most pitiable in the world are the cruel, evil-minded men, / foolish mortals who consume meat, a mine of all evils!
Meat is not the cause of long life, nor of health, nor of strength; / all this is false. Hear now an example:
Even meat-eaters are seen afflicted by disease, weak, / and short-lived; realizing this, avoid meat from afar.

5.29.s:
amāṃsādā api kṣmāyāṃ dṛśyaṃte rogavarjitāḥ ..
cirāyuṣaśca pīnāṃgāsta smānmāṃsaṃ vivarjayet .. 6.29.230 ..
yo bhakṣayati māṃsāni sattvānāṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām ..
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tatrastho bhakṣyate ca taiḥ .. 231 ..
na hi māṃsaṃ tṛṇātkāṣṭhādupalādapi jāyate ..
hate jaṃtau bhavenmāṃsaṃ tasmāttatparivarjayet .. 232 ..
etadeva hi dṛṣṭāṃtaṃ māṃsasya parivarjane ..
yadaṃgaṃ hriyate svaṃ ca kaṃṭakenāpi vikṣatam ..233..
ātmaupamyena bhūtāni tasmātsarvāṇi paṃḍitaiḥ ..
draṣṭavyāni na hiṃsyāni rakṣaṇīyāni śaktitaḥ .. 234 ..
haṃtā caivānumaṃtā ca viśastā krayavikrayī ..
saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaścāṣṭa ghātakāḥ .. 235 ..
dhanena krayakṛddhaṃti bhakṣaṇena ca khādakaḥ ..
ghātako vadhabaṃdhābhyāmityanyastrividho vadhaḥ .. 236 ..
5.29.d:
अमांसादा अपि क्ष्मायां दृश्यंते रोगवर्जिताः ..
चिरायुषश्च पीनांगास्त स्मान्मांसं विवर्जयेत् .. 6.29.230 ..
यो भक्षयति मांसानि सत्त्वानां जीवितैषिणाम् ..
स याति नरकं घोरं तत्रस्थो भक्ष्यते च तैः .. 231 ..
न हि मांसं तृणात्काष्ठादुपलादपि जायते ..
हते जंतौ भवेन्मांसं तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् .. 232 ..
एतदेव हि दृष्टांतं मांसस्य परिवर्जने ..
यदंगं ह्रियते स्वं च कंटकेनापि विक्षतम् ..233..
आत्मौपम्येन भूतानि तस्मात्सर्वाणि पंडितैः ..
द्रष्टव्यानि न हिंस्यानि रक्षणीयानि शक्तितः .. 234 ..
हंता चैवानुमंता च विशस्ता क्रयविक्रयी ..
संस्कर्ता चोपहर्ता च खादकश्चाष्ट घातकाः .. 235 ..
धनेन क्रयकृद्धंति भक्षणेन च खादकः ..
घातको वधबंधाभ्यामित्यन्यस्त्रिविधो वधः .. 236 ..
5.29.m:
Non-meat-eaters too are seen on earth free from disease, / long-lived, and full-bodied; therefore, one should completely abandon meat.
He who eats the flesh of living beings that desire to live / goes to a terrible hell, and staying there, he is eaten by them.
Meat certainly does not come from grass, from wood, or even from stone; / meat comes into being when a creature is killed; therefore, one should abandon it.
This itself is the example for the abandonment of meat: / that one’s own limb suffers pain even when pricked by a thorn.
Therefore, all creatures should be regarded by the wise / as equal to oneself; they should not be harmed, but protected according to one's ability.
The killer, the consenter, the slaughterer, the buyer, the seller, / the preparer, the server, and the eater—these eight are slayers.
The buyer slays with money, and the eater slays by consuming; / the killer slays by striking and binding—thus killing is threefold in another way.

5.29.s:
karmaṇā manasā vācā yo hinasti na kiṃcana ..
sa prāpnoti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarā maraṇavarjitam .. 237 ..
śākamūlaphalāhāro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ..
na tasya phalamāpnoti yadi hiṃsāparo naraḥ .. 238 ..
eko varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapastapati dustaram ..
ahiṃsānirato yastu tayoḥ śreṣṭho dayānvitaḥ .. 239 ..
yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ duṣprāpamapi mānavaḥ ..
taṃ tamāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadi syātsudayānvitaḥ .. 6.29.240 ..
kāmagena vimānena divyastrīśatasevitaḥ ..
devavanmodate svarge savabhūtābhayapradaḥ .. 241 ..
evamuktvā mahātmā sa paśyato mama sūtaja ..
vimānavaramāruhya gataśca tridivālayam .. 242 ..
gandharvairgīyamānastu stūyamānaśca kinnaraiḥ ..
ṣaḍakṣarasya maṃtrasya māhātmye na mahāmate .. 243 ..
5.29.d:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यो हिनस्ति न किंचन ..
स प्राप्नोति परं स्थानं जरा मरणवर्जितम् .. 237 ..
शाकमूलफलाहारो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः ..
न तस्य फलमाप्नोति यदि हिंसापरो नरः .. 238 ..
एको वर्षशतं साग्रं तपस्तपति दुस्तरम् ..
अहिंसानिरतो यस्तु तयोः श्रेष्ठो दयान्वितः .. 239 ..
यंयं कामयते कामं दुष्प्रापमपि मानवः ..
तं तमाप्नोत्यसंदिग्धं यदि स्यात्सुदयान्वितः .. 6.29.240 ..
कामगेन विमानेन दिव्यस्त्रीशतसेवितः ..
देववन्मोदते स्वर्गे सवभूताभयप्रदः .. 241 ..
एवमुक्त्वा महात्मा स पश्यतो मम सूतज ..
विमानवरमारुह्य गतश्च त्रिदिवालयम् .. 242 ..
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानस्तु स्तूयमानश्च किन्नरैः ..
षडक्षरस्य मंत्रस्य माहात्म्ये न महामते .. 243 ..
5.29.m:
He who injures nothing by deed, mind, or speech / attains the supreme realm, free from old age and death.
Eating only vegetables, roots, and fruits, devoted to celibacy— / a man does not attain their fruit if he is intent on violence.
One man performs severe austerity for a full hundred years; / but he who is devoted to non-violence—of the two, the compassionate one is superior.
Whatever desire a human being desires, even if difficult to obtain, / he certainly attains that, if he is endowed with great compassion.
In an aerial chariot moving at will, served by hundreds of celestial women, / he rejoices in heaven like a god, having granted fearlessness to all creatures.’
Having spoken thus while I watched, O son of Sūta, that great-souled one / mounted an excellent aerial chariot and went to the heavenly abode,
being sung to by gandharvas and praised by kinnaras, / through the māhātmya of the six-syllable mantra, O noble-minded one.

5.29.s:
tasmingate tadā svargaṃ duḥkhaṃ me samupasthitam ..
smṛtvā pūrvaṃ hatānsarpānbhagnagātro'bhavaṃ tadā .. 244 ..
tato'haṃ kṛtavāṃstatra vipralāpānanekaśaḥ ..
svakarmabhayasaṃtrastastasminneva mahāvane .. 245 ..
aho mayā nṛśaṃsena bahavaḥ prāṇino hatāḥ ..
ninditaśca mahādevo nara kārtirbhaviṣyati .. 246 ..
so'haṃ hiṃsāṃ parityajya cariṣyāmi mahattapaḥ ..
śivadīkṣāṃ samāsādya pūjayiṣye maheśvaram .. 247 ..
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu prārthayaṃti narāḥ sukham ..
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tasmātkāryaṃ mayā tapaḥ .. 248 ..
adhunaiko'hamekāhamekaikasminvanaspatau ..
caranbhaikṣaṃ munirmaunī cariṣyāmyāśramānimān .. 249 ..
pāṃsunā samavacchannaḥ śūnyāgārapratiśrayaḥ ..
vṛkṣamūlaniketo vā tyaktasarvapriyāpriyaḥ .. 6.29.250 ..
5.29.d:
तस्मिन्गते तदा स्वर्गं दुःखं मे समुपस्थितम् ..
स्मृत्वा पूर्वं हतान्सर्पान्भग्नगात्रोऽभवं तदा .. 244 ..
ततोऽहं कृतवांस्तत्र विप्रलापाननेकशः ..
स्वकर्मभयसंत्रस्तस्तस्मिन्नेव महावने .. 245 ..
अहो मया नृशंसेन बहवः प्राणिनो हताः ..
निन्दितश्च महादेवो नर कार्तिर्भविष्यति .. 246 ..
सोऽहं हिंसां परित्यज्य चरिष्यामि महत्तपः ..
शिवदीक्षां समासाद्य पूजयिष्ये महेश्वरम् .. 247 ..
यत्किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रार्थयंति नराः सुखम् ..
तत्सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तस्मात्कार्यं मया तपः .. 248 ..
अधुनैकोऽहमेकाहमेकैकस्मिन्वनस्पतौ ..
चरन्भैक्षं मुनिर्मौनी चरिष्याम्याश्रमानिमान् .. 249 ..
पांसुना समवच्छन्नः शून्यागारप्रतिश्रयः ..
वृक्षमूलनिकेतो वा त्यक्तसर्वप्रियाप्रियः .. 6.29.250 ..
5.29.m:
When he had gone to heaven, grief came upon me then; / remembering the snakes killed before, I became paralyzed in body.
Then I uttered many laments there, / terrified by the fear of my own actions, in that very great forest:
‘Alas, by cruel me many living creatures have been killed, / and Mahādeva has been reviled! Suffering in hell will be mine.
Abandoning violence, I shall perform great austerity; / having received the initiation of Śiva, I will worship Maheśvara.’
Whatever happiness men pray for in the three worlds, / all that is to be attained by austerity; therefore, austerity must be performed by me.
Now, alone, [spending] a single day at each single tree, / begging for alms, a silent sage, I shall wander through these hermitages.
Covered with dust, taking shelter in deserted houses, / or having my dwelling at the foot of trees, having abandoned everything pleasant and unpleasant.

5.29.s:
evaṃ vilapya yatnena mayā sūtakulodvaha ..
gṛhītaṃ bhaktiyuktena śivadīkṣāvrataṃ tataḥ .. 251 ..
ṣaḍakṣarasya maṃtrasya ayutaṃ prajapāmyaham ..
trisandhyaṃ śraddhayā yuktaḥ siddheśvarasamīpataḥ .. 252 ..
tatprabhāvena me sthairyaṃ saṃjātaṃ yauvanodbhavam ..
tathā lokātaṃrajñānaṃ khecaratvaṃ ca sūtaja .. 253 ..
siddheśvaraṃ prayāsyāmi dvāparāṃte hyavasthite ..
sadāśivaṃ prayāsyāmi satyametanmayoditam .. 254 ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā sūtaja mokṣadam ..
ṣaḍakṣarasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 255 ..
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpātso'pi mucyeta mānavaḥ ... .. 256 ..
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahābhāga mantramenaṃ sadā japa ..
saṃprāpsyasi parānkāmānmanasā vāṃchitānsadā .. 257 ..
5.29.d:
एवं विलप्य यत्नेन मया सूतकुलोद्वह ..
गृहीतं भक्तियुक्तेन शिवदीक्षाव्रतं ततः .. 251 ..
षडक्षरस्य मंत्रस्य अयुतं प्रजपाम्यहम् ..
त्रिसन्ध्यं श्रद्धया युक्तः सिद्धेश्वरसमीपतः .. 252 ..
तत्प्रभावेन मे स्थैर्यं संजातं यौवनोद्भवम् ..
तथा लोकातंरज्ञानं खेचरत्वं च सूतज .. 253 ..
सिद्धेश्वरं प्रयास्यामि द्वापरांते ह्यवस्थिते ..
सदाशिवं प्रयास्यामि सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 254 ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया सूतज मोक्षदम् ..
षडक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 255 ..
यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
आजन्ममरणात्पापात्सोऽपि मुच्येत मानवः ... .. 256 ..
तस्मात्त्वं हि महाभाग मन्त्रमेनं सदा जप ..
संप्राप्स्यसि परान्कामान्मनसा वांछितान्सदा .. 257 ..
5.29.m:
Lamenting thus, O uplifter of the Sūta race, / the observance of Śiva’s initiation was then undertaken with effort and devotion by me.
Near Siddheśvara, endowed with faith, / I constantly mutter ten thousand repetitions of the six-syllable mantra at the three twilights.
By its power, my firmness born of youth has arisen, / as well as knowledge of other worlds and the ability to move through the sky, O son of Sūta.
When the end of the Dvāpara age arrives, I shall go to Siddheśvara; / I shall go to Sadāśiva: this which has been spoken by me is the truth.
All this granting liberation has been related to you by me, O son of Sūta, / the māhātmya of the six-syllable [mantra] that destroys all sin.
And whatever man should constantly hear this endowed with proper faith, / he too would be freed from the sins accumulated from birth to death.
Therefore, O highly fortunate one, constantly recite this mantra; / you will always attain the supreme desires wished for by your mind.

5.29.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
etacchrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ sakāśāttasya sadguroḥ ..
ṣaḍakṣarasya māhātmyaṃ yadyuṣmākaṃ prakīrtitam .. 258 ..
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ śatrupakṣakṣayāvaham ..
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nityaṃ sarvakāmābhayapradam .. 259 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye ṣaḍakṣaramantramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 29 .. .. dha ..
5.29.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
एतच्छ्रुतं मया पूर्वं सकाशात्तस्य सद्गुरोः ..
षडक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं यद्युष्माकं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 258 ..
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं शत्रुपक्षक्षयावहम् ..
पठतां शृण्वतां नित्यं सर्वकामाभयप्रदम् .. 259 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये षडक्षरमन्त्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 29 .. .. ध ..
5.29.m:
Sūta said:
This māhātmya of the six-syllable [mantra] was heard by me before from the presence of that good guru, / which has now been proclaimed to you.
It brings fortune, renown, long life, and destruction to the faction of enemies; / to those who constantly read or hear it, it bestows all desires and fearlessness.
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara in the Māhātmya of the Six-Syllable Mantra,’ in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.30.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
toṣitaḥ kena siddhena tatra siddheśvaro vibhuḥ ..
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistarātsūtanandana .. 1 ..
5.30.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
तोषितः केन सिद्धेन तत्र सिद्धेश्वरो विभुः ..
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व विस्तरात्सूतनन्दन .. 1 ..
5.30.m:
The seers said:
By which Siddha was the all-pervading lord Siddheśvara propitiated there? / Explain all this in detail, O delight of Sūta.

5.30.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītsiddhādhiponāma purā haṃsa iti smṛtaḥ ..
anapatyatayā tasya kālaścakrāma bhūriśaḥ .. 2 ..
5.30.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीत्सिद्धाधिपोनाम पुरा हंस इति स्मृतः ..
अनपत्यतया तस्य कालश्चक्राम भूरिशः .. 2 ..
5.30.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, there was a lord of the Siddhas known by the name of Haṃsa; / because he was childless, a great amount of time passed for him.

5.30.s:
tataścintā prapannaḥ sa gatvā devapurohitam ..
papracchāgirasaḥ putraṃ vipraśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim .. 3 ..
5.30.d:
ततश्चिन्ता प्रपन्नः स गत्वा देवपुरोहितम् ..
पप्रच्छागिरसः पुत्रं विप्रश्रेष्ठं बृहस्पतिम् .. 3 ..
5.30.m: Then, seized by sorrow, he went to the priest of the gods, / the son of Aṅgiras, the best of brahmins, Bṛhaspati, and asked him:

5.30.s:
bhagavaṃścānapatyasya vārddhakaṃ me samāgatam ..
tasmādapatyalābhāya mamopāyaṃ prakīrtaya .. 4 ..
5.30.d:
भगवंश्चानपत्यस्य वार्द्धकं मे समागतम् ..
तस्मादपत्यलाभाय ममोपायं प्रकीर्तय .. 4 ..
5.30.m: “O venerable one, old age has arrived for me, and I am childless; / therefore, proclaim to me the means for obtaining offspring,

5.30.s:
tīrthayātrāṃ vrataṃ vāpi śāṃtikaṃ vā dvijottama ..
yena syātsaṃtatiḥ śīghraṃ tvatprasādādbṛhaspate .. 5 ..
5.30.d:
तीर्थयात्रां व्रतं वापि शांतिकं वा द्विजोत्तम ..
येन स्यात्संततिः शीघ्रं त्वत्प्रसादाद्बृहस्पते .. 5 ..
5.30.m: a pilgrimage to sacred fords, a vow, or a propitiatory rite, O best of the twice-born, / by which progeny may quickly come about through your grace, O Bṛhaspati.”

5.30.s:
bṛhaspatiściraṃ dhyātvā siddhaṃ prāha tataḥ param ..
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ gatvā tatra tapaḥ kuru .. 6 ..
5.30.d:
बृहस्पतिश्चिरं ध्यात्वा सिद्धं प्राह ततः परम् ..
चमत्कारपुरं क्षेत्रं गत्वा तत्र तपः कुरु .. 6 ..
5.30.m: After meditating for a long time, Bṛhaspati then said to the Siddha: / “Go to the sacred field of Camatkārapura and perform austerity there.

5.30.s:
tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ vaṃśoddhārakṣamaṃ śubham ..
nānyaṃ paśyāmi siddheśa sutopāyaṃ śubhāvaham .. 7 ..
5.30.d:
ततः प्राप्स्यसि सत्पुत्रं वंशोद्धारक्षमं शुभम् ..
नान्यं पश्यामि सिद्धेश सुतोपायं शुभावहम् .. 7 ..
5.30.m: Then you will obtain an auspicious, noble son capable of uplifting your lineage; / O lord of Siddhas, I see no other auspicious means for [gaining] a son.”

5.30.s:
tatastatkṣetramāsādya sa siddhaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
liṃgaṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa yathoktavidhinā svayam .. 8 ..
5.30.d:
ततस्तत्क्षेत्रमासाद्य स सिद्धः श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
लिंगं संपूजयामास यथोक्तविधिना स्वयम् .. 8 ..
5.30.m: Then, having reached that sacred field, that Siddha, endowed with faith, / himself worshipped the liṅga according to the prescribed rules.

5.30.s:
tataścārādhayāmāsa divānaktamataṃdritaḥ ..
bali pūjopahāreṇa gītavādyocchrayādibhiḥ .. 9 ..
5.30.d:
ततश्चाराधयामास दिवानक्तमतंद्रितः ..
बलि पूजोपहारेण गीतवाद्योच्छ्रयादिभिः .. 9 ..
5.30.m: Unwearied by day and night, he then worshipped [it] / with offerings of food, worship, gifts, and the performance of vocal and instrumental music.

5.30.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇaistathā kṛcchraiḥ pārākairdvijasattamāḥ ..
tathā māsopavāsaiśca toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram .. 6.30.10 ..
5.30.d:
चांद्रायणैस्तथा कृच्छ्रैः पाराकैर्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तथा मासोपवासैश्च तोषयामास शंकरम् .. 6.30.10 ..
5.30.m: By means of cāndrāyaṇa penances, kṛcchra penances, and parāka penances, O best of the twice-born, / and by fasts lasting for a month, he propitiated Śaṃkara.

5.30.s:
tato varṣasahasrābhyāṃ tasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā vṛṣārūḍhaḥ sahomayā .. 11 ..
5.30.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्राभ्यां तस्य तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
प्रोवाच दर्शनं गत्वा वृषारूढः सहोमया .. 11 ..
5.30.m: Then, after two thousand years, Maheśvara was pleased with him; / mounted on a bull along with Umā, he went into his vision and said:

5.30.s:
haṃsādya tava tuṣṭo'haṃ tasmātprārthaya vāṃchitam ..
ahaṃ te saṃpradāsyāmi duṣprāpyamapi niścitam .. 12 ..
5.30.d:
हंसाद्य तव तुष्टोऽहं तस्मात्प्रार्थय वांछितम् ..
अहं ते संप्रदास्यामि दुष्प्राप्यमपि निश्चितम् .. 12 ..
5.30.m: “O Haṃsa, today I am pleased with you; therefore, ask for what you desire; / I shall certainly grant it to you, even if it is difficult to attain.”

5.30.s:
.. haṃsa uvāca .. ..
apatyārthaṃ samāraṃbho mayā'dya vihitaḥ purā ..
tasmāttvaṃ dehi me putrānvaṃśoddhārakṣa mānvibho .. 13 ..
5.30.d:
.. हंस उवाच .. ..
अपत्यार्थं समारंभो मयाऽद्य विहितः पुरा ..
तस्मात्त्वं देहि मे पुत्रान्वंशोद्धारक्ष मान्विभो .. 13 ..
5.30.m:
Haṃsa said:
“Formerly, an undertaking for the sake of offspring was initiated by me; / therefore, grant me sons capable of uplifting my lineage, O lord.

5.30.s:
tvayā caiva sadā liṃge stheyamatra surottama ..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ sarvalokahitārthataḥ .. 14 ..
.. śrībhagavānuvāca ..
adyaprabhṛti liṃgesminnāśrayo me bhaviṣyati ..
tava vākyena siddheśa satyametanmayoditam ...5..
5.30.d:
त्वया चैव सदा लिंगे स्थेयमत्र सुरोत्तम ..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धं सर्वलोकहितार्थतः .. 14 ..
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
अद्यप्रभृति लिंगेस्मिन्नाश्रयो मे भविष्यति ..
तव वाक्येन सिद्धेश सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ...5..
5.30.m:
And you must always remain here in this liṅga, O best of the gods, / undoubtedly at my request, for the sake of the welfare of all the worlds.”
The Holy Lord said:
“From this day forward, my dwelling will be in this liṅga / at your word, O lord of Siddhas; this which has been spoken by me is the truth.

5.30.s:
yo māmatra sthitaṃ martyaḥ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ..
tasyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi cittasthaṃ sakalaṃ phalam .. 16 ..
5.30.d:
यो मामत्र स्थितं मर्त्यः पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः ..
तस्याहं संप्रदास्यामि चित्तस्थं सकलं फलम् .. 16 ..
5.30.m: Whatever mortal will worship me residing here with devotion, / to him I will give all the fruit abiding in his heart.

5.30.s:
yo me liṃgasya yāmyāśāṃ sthitvā maṃtraṃ japiṣyati ..
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ pradāsyāmi tasyāyuṣyaṃ sutānvitam .... .. 17 ..
5.30.d:
यो मे लिंगस्य याम्याशां स्थित्वा मंत्रं जपिष्यति ..
षडक्षरं प्रदास्यामि तस्यायुष्यं सुतान्वितम् .... .. 17 ..
5.30.m: Whoever, standing in the southern direction of my liṅga, will recite the mantra / of six syllables, to him I will give long life accompanied by sons.”

5.30.s:
evamuktvā mahādevastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
haṃso'pi ca gṛhaṃ gatvā putrānāpa mahodayān.. 18 ..
5.30.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
हंसोऽपि च गृहं गत्वा पुत्रानाप महोदयान्.. 18 ..
5.30.m: Having spoken thus, the great god then disappeared from sight; / and Haṃsa, having returned home, obtained highly prosperous sons.

5.30.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena talliṃgaṃ yatnato dvijāḥ ..
sparśanīyaṃ ca pūjyaṃ ca namaskāryaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 19 ..
5.30.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तल्लिंगं यत्नतो द्विजाः ..
स्पर्शनीयं च पूज्यं च नमस्कार्यं प्रयत्नतः .. 19 ..
5.30.m: Therefore, by every effort, that liṅga should be carefully touched, / worshipped, and saluted with diligence, O twice-born,

5.30.s:
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa kīrtanīyaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ..
vāṃchadbhirvāṃchitānkāmāndurlabhāṃstridaśairapi ..6.30.20..
5.30.d:
षडक्षरेण मन्त्रेण कीर्तनीयं च शक्तितः ..
वांछद्भिर्वांछितान्कामान्दुर्लभांस्त्रिदशैरपि ..6.30.20..
5.30.m: and celebrated according to one's power with the six-syllable mantra / by those who desire desired objects, which are difficult even for the thirty gods to attain.

5.30.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvarotpattivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 30 .. .. va ..
5.30.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. .. 30 .. .. व ..
5.30.m: Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Account of the Origin of Siddheśvara,’ in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti nāgatīrthamanuttamam..
yatra snātasya sarpāṇāṃ na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit.. 1 ..
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति नागतीर्थमनुत्तमम्..
यत्र स्नातस्य सर्पाणां न भयं जायते क्वचित्.. 1 ..
5.31.m:
Sūta said:
Likewise, there is another unexcelled sacred ford there called Nāgatīrtha, / where, for one who has bathed, no fear of serpents arises anywhere.

5.31.s:
tatra śrāvaṇapañcamyāṃ yo naraḥ snānamācaret ..
kṛṣṇāyāṃ na bhayaṃ tasya kule'pi syādaheḥ kvacit .. 2 ..
5.31.d:
तत्र श्रावणपञ्चम्यां यो नरः स्नानमाचरेत् ..
कृष्णायां न भयं तस्य कुलेऽपि स्यादहेः क्वचित् .. 2 ..
5.31.m: Whatever man performs ritual ablution there on the fifth day / of the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, no fear from a serpent will ever befall even his family.

5.31.s:
tatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ mātuḥ śāpaprapīḍitaiḥ ..
śeṣa prabhṛtināgaistu muktihetorhutāśanāt .. 3 ..
5.31.d:
तत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं मातुः शापप्रपीडितैः ..
शेष प्रभृतिनागैस्तु मुक्तिहेतोर्हुताशनात् .. 3 ..
5.31.m: Formerly, austerity was performed there by the nāgas, beginning with Śeṣa, / who were afflicted by their mother’s curse, for the sake of liberation from the fire.

5.31.s:
kambalāśvatarau nāgau tathā khyātau dharātale ..
tatra taptvā tapastīvraṃ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatau .. 4 ..
5.31.d:
कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ तथा ख्यातौ धरातले ..
तत्र तप्त्वा तपस्तीव्रं संसिद्धिं परमां गतौ .. 4 ..
5.31.m: The two nāgas Kambala and Aśvatara, renowned on the surface of the earth, / having performed severe austerity there, attained supreme perfection.

5.31.s:
anaṃto vāsukiścaiva takṣakaśca mahāvalaḥ ..
karkoṭaścaiva nāgendro maṇikaṇṭhastathāparaḥ ..5..
5.31.d:
अनंतो वासुकिश्चैव तक्षकश्च महावलः ..
कर्कोटश्चैव नागेन्द्रो मणिकण्ठस्तथापरः ..5..
5.31.m: Ananta, Vāsuki, and the mighty Takṣaka, / and Karkoṭa the king of nāgas, and another named Maṇikaṇṭha,

5.31.s:
airāvatastathā śaṃkhaḥ puṇḍarīko mahāviṣaḥ ..
śeṣapūrvāḥ smṛtā nāgā ete'tra nava nāyakāḥ .. 6 ..
5.31.d:
ऐरावतस्तथा शंखः पुण्डरीको महाविषः ..
शेषपूर्वाः स्मृता नागा एतेऽत्र नव नायकाः .. 6 ..
5.31.m: Airāvata, Śaṅkha, and Puṇḍarīka of great venom: / these nine leaders are remembered as the nāgas headed by Śeṣa.

5.31.s:
eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca teṣāmapi vibhūtibhiḥ ..
asaṃkhyābhiridaṃ vyāptaṃ samastaṃ dharaṇītalam.. 7 ..
5.31.d:
एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च तेषामपि विभूतिभिः ..
असंख्याभिरिदं व्याप्तं समस्तं धरणीतलम्.. 7 ..
5.31.m: By their sons and grandsons, and also by their innumerable / manifestations, this entire surface of the earth is pervaded.

5.31.s:
atha te kuṭilā duṣṭā bhakṣayaṃti sadā janān ..
bahutvādapi saṃsparśādaparādhaṃ vināpi ca .. 8 ..
5.31.d:
अथ ते कुटिला दुष्टा भक्षयंति सदा जनान् ..
बहुत्वादपि संस्पर्शादपराधं विनापि च .. 8 ..
5.31.m: Then, crooked and wicked, they continually devoured people, / both because of their great numbers and through mere touch, even without any offence [on the people's part].

5.31.s:
tataḥ prajā imāḥ sarvā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
pīḍitāḥ sma suraśreṣṭha sarpebhyo rakṣa satvaram .. 9 ..
5.31.d:
ततः प्रजा इमाः सर्वा ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः ..
पीडिताः स्म सुरश्रेष्ठ सर्पेभ्यो रक्ष सत्वरम् .. 9 ..
5.31.m: Then all these creatures went to Brahmā for refuge: / "We are afflicted, O best of gods! Protect us quickly from the serpents,

5.31.s:
yāvanna śūnyatāṃ yāti sakalaṃ vasudhātalam ..
vyāptaṃ sarvaistataḥ sarpairviṣāḍhyairatibhīṣaṇaiḥ .. 6.31.10 ..
5.31.d:
यावन्न शून्यतां याति सकलं वसुधातलम् ..
व्याप्तं सर्वैस्ततः सर्पैर्विषाढ्यैरतिभीषणैः .. 6.31.10 ..
5.31.m: before the entire surface of the earth becomes completely empty! / For it is wholly overrun with serpents, filled with poison and extremely terrifying."

5.31.s:
atha tānabravīdbrahmā śeṣādyānnavanāyakān..
svasaṃtateḥ prarakṣadhvaṃ bhakṣyamāṇā imāḥ prajāḥ .. 11 ..
te tatheti pratijñāya jagmuḥ sarve bhujaṃgamāḥ ...2..
5.31.d:
अथ तानब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा शेषाद्यान्नवनायकान्..
स्वसंततेः प्ररक्षध्वं भक्ष्यमाणा इमाः प्रजाः .. 11 ..
ते तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जग्मुः सर्वे भुजंगमाः ...2..
5.31.m:
Then Brahmā said to those nine leaders headed by Śeṣa: / "Protect these creatures who are being devoured by your own offspring!"
They agreed, saying "So be it," and all the serpents departed.

5.31.s:
atha teṣāṃ bahutvācca naiva rakṣā prajāyate ..
vāritā api te yasmātprakurvaṃti prajākṣayam .. 13 ..
5.31.d:
अथ तेषां बहुत्वाच्च नैव रक्षा प्रजायते ..
वारिता अपि ते यस्मात्प्रकुर्वंति प्रजाक्षयम् .. 13 ..
5.31.m: Then, because of their great numbers, no protection was brought about at all; / for even though restrained, they continued to bring destruction upon the creatures.

5.31.s:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā tānāhūya kulādhipān..
tānuvāca svayaṃ brahmā sarvadevasamāgame .. 14 ..
5.31.d:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा तानाहूय कुलाधिपान्..
तानुवाच स्वयं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवसमागमे .. 14 ..
5.31.m: Then Brahmā himself, his soul filled with anger, summoned those chiefs of the clans / and spoke to them in an assembly of all the gods:

5.31.s:
bhakṣayaṃti yataḥ sarpā aparādhaṃ vinā prajāḥ ..
vāritā api te tasmāttānnigṛhṇāmi sāṃpratam .. 15 ..
bhaviṣyati mahīpālo bhūtale janamejayaḥ..
citrabhānurmakhe tasya sarpānsaṃbhakṣayiṣyati ...6..
mātuḥ śāpādviśeṣeṇa maṃtrākṛṣṭā dvijottamaiḥ ..
svayameva patiṣyaṃti susamiddhe hutāśane ...7..
5.31.d:
भक्षयंति यतः सर्पा अपराधं विना प्रजाः ..
वारिता अपि ते तस्मात्तान्निगृह्णामि सांप्रतम् .. 15 ..
भविष्यति महीपालो भूतले जनमेजयः..
चित्रभानुर्मखे तस्य सर्पान्संभक्षयिष्यति ...6..
मातुः शापाद्विशेषेण मंत्राकृष्टा द्विजोत्तमैः ..
स्वयमेव पतिष्यंति सुसमिद्धे हुताशने ...7..
5.31.m:
"Since the serpents devour creatures without any offence, / even though restrained, I shall therefore punish them now.
There will be a king on earth named Janamejaya; / Fire will consume the serpents in his sacrifice.
Particularly due to their mother's curse, drawn by the mantras of the best of brahmins, / they will fall of their own accord into the blazing fire."

5.31.s:
tacchrutvā vepamānāste sarpāṇāṃ navanāyakāḥ ..
procuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sadyaḥ praṇipatya pitāmaham.. 18 ..
bhagavankuṭilā jñātirasmākaṃ bhavatā kṛtā ..
tatkasmātkuruṣe kopaṃ jātidharmānuvartinām...9..
5.31.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वेपमानास्ते सर्पाणां नवनायकाः ..
प्रोचुः प्रांजलयः सद्यः प्रणिपत्य पितामहम्.. 18 ..
भगवन्कुटिला ज्ञातिरस्माकं भवता कृता ..
तत्कस्मात्कुरुषे कोपं जातिधर्मानुवर्तिनाम्...9..
5.31.m:
Hearing that, trembling, those nine leaders of the serpents / bowed down to the Grandfather and immediately spoke with joined palms:
"O Lord, you created our crooked species. / Why then do you show anger towards those who are merely following the nature of their kind?"

5.31.s:
brahmovāca..
yadi nāma mayā sṛṣṭā yūyaṃ diṣṭyā viṣolbaṇāḥ 0.
aparādhaṃ vinā kasmādbhakṣayadhva imāḥ prajāḥ .. 6.31.20 ..
5.31.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच..
यदि नाम मया सृष्टा यूयं दिष्ट्या विषोल्बणाः 0.
अपराधं विना कस्माद्भक्षयध्व इमाः प्रजाः .. 6.31.20 ..
5.31.m: Brahmā said: / "Even if you were indeed created by me as fiercely venomous by destiny, / why do you devour these creatures without any offence?"

5.31.s:
.. nāgā ūcuḥ .. ..
maryādāṃ kuru deveśa asmākaṃ mānavaiḥ saha ..
athavā saṃprayacchasva sthānaṃ mānuṣavarjitam .. .. 21 ..
5.31.d:
.. नागा ऊचुः .. ..
मर्यादां कुरु देवेश अस्माकं मानवैः सह ..
अथवा संप्रयच्छस्व स्थानं मानुषवर्जितम् .. .. 21 ..
5.31.m: The nāgas said: / "Establish a boundary, O Lord of gods, between us and human beings; / or else assign us a place devoid of humans.

5.31.s:
pārikṣitamakhe tasminsarpāṇāṃ citrabhānunā ..
samaṃtāddahyamānānāṃ rakṣopāyaṃ praciṃtaya .. 22 ..
5.31.d:
पारिक्षितमखे तस्मिन्सर्पाणां चित्रभानुना ..
समंताद्दह्यमानानां रक्षोपायं प्रचिंतय .. 22 ..
5.31.m: Devise a means of protection for the serpents who will be burnt / on all sides by Fire in that sacrifice of Parīkṣit's son.

5.31.s:
yathā na saṃtaticchedo jāyate prapitāmaha ..
asmākaṃ sarvalokeṣu tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 23 ..
5.31.d:
यथा न संततिच्छेदो जायते प्रपितामह ..
अस्माकं सर्वलोकेषु तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 23 ..
5.31.m: O Great-Grandfather, you ought to act in such a way / that there is no destruction of our lineage throughout all the worlds."

5.31.s:
.. brahmovāca.. ..
jaratkāruriti khyāto bhaviṣyati kvaciddvijaḥ ..
sa saṃtānakṛte bhāryāṃ bhūmāvanveṣayiṣyati .. 24 ..
5.31.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच.. ..
जरत्कारुरिति ख्यातो भविष्यति क्वचिद्द्विजः ..
स संतानकृते भार्यां भूमावन्वेषयिष्यति .. 24 ..
5.31.m: Brahmā said: / "There will be a certain brahmin known as Jaratkāru; / he will search on earth for a wife for the sake of offspring.

5.31.s:
bhāvinī ca bhavadvaṃśe jaratkanyā suśobhanā ..
sā deyā cādarāttasmai putrārthaṃ varavarṇinī .. 25 ..
5.31.d:
भाविनी च भवद्वंशे जरत्कन्या सुशोभना ..
सा देया चादरात्तस्मै पुत्रार्थं वरवर्णिनी .. 25 ..
5.31.m: And in your lineage there will be a maiden named Jaratkanyā, very fair; / that woman of excellent complexion must be given to him with respect for the sake of a son.

5.31.s:
tābhyāṃ yo bhavitā putraḥ sa śeṣānrakṣayiṣyati ..
sarpāñchuddhasamācārānmaryādāsu vyavasthitān .. 26 ..
5.31.d:
ताभ्यां यो भविता पुत्रः स शेषान्रक्षयिष्यति ..
सर्पाञ्छुद्धसमाचारान्मर्यादासु व्यवस्थितान् .. 26 ..
5.31.m: The son who will be born of those two will protect the rest— / the serpents of pure conduct who abide by the boundaries.

5.31.s:
sutalaṃ nitalaṃ caiva tathaiva vitalaṃ ca yat ..
tasyādhastāccaturthe ca vasatirvo dharātale .. 27 ..
5.31.d:
सुतलं नितलं चैव तथैव वितलं च यत् ..
तस्याधस्ताच्चतुर्थे च वसतिर्वो धरातले .. 27 ..
5.31.m: Below Sutala, Nitala, and likewise Vitala, / on the fourth level of the subterranean world, your dwelling shall be,

5.31.s:
mayā datte'tiramye ca sarvabhogasamanvite ..
tasmādvrajata tatraiva parityajya mahītalam .. 28 ..
5.31.d:
मया दत्तेऽतिरम्ये च सर्वभोगसमन्विते ..
तस्माद्व्रजत तत्रैव परित्यज्य महीतलम् .. 28 ..
5.31.m: granted by me, exceedingly delightful, and endowed with all enjoyments. / Therefore depart to that very place, leaving the surface of the earth.

5.31.s:
tatra bhuṃjatha sadbhogā ngatvā''śu mama śāsanāt ..
putrapautrasamopetāṃstridaśairapi durlabhān .. 29 ..
5.31.d:
तत्र भुंजथ सद्भोगा न्गत्वा'ऽशु मम शासनात् ..
पुत्रपौत्रसमोपेतांस्त्रिदशैरपि दुर्लभान् .. 29 ..
5.31.m: Having gone there quickly by my command, enjoy good pleasures / along with your sons and grandsons, pleasures difficult to attain even for the gods."

5.31.s:
.. nāgā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhogānapi prabhuṃjānā na vayaṃ tatra padmaja ..
śaknumo vastumurvyāṃ nastasmātsthānaṃ pradarśaya ..
maryādayā vartayāmo yatrasthā mānavaiḥ samam .. 6.31.30 ..
5.31.d:
.. नागा ऊचुः .. ..
भोगानपि प्रभुंजाना न वयं तत्र पद्मज ..
शक्नुमो वस्तुमुर्व्यां नस्तस्मात्स्थानं प्रदर्शय ..
मर्यादया वर्तयामो यत्रस्था मानवैः समम् .. 6.31.30 ..
5.31.m: The nāgas said: / "Even while experiencing enjoyments there, O lotus-born one, we cannot / dwell [exclusively there]; therefore show us a place on the earth / where we may abide according to a boundary together with human beings."

5.31.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
eṣā tithirmayā dattā yuṣmākaṃ dharaṇītale ..
paṃcamī śeṣakālastu neyastatraṃ rasātale .. 31 ..
5.31.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एषा तिथिर्मया दत्ता युष्माकं धरणीतले ..
पंचमी शेषकालस्तु नेयस्तत्रं रसातले .. 31 ..
5.31.m: Brahmā said: / "This lunar day on the surface of the earth has been granted by me to you: / the fifth. The rest of the time, however, must be spent there in Rasātala.

5.31.s:
tatrāgatairna haṃtavyā mānavā doṣavarjitāḥ ..
maṃtrasaṃrakṣitāṃgāśca tathauṣadhikṛtādarāḥ .. 32 ..
5.31.d:
तत्रागतैर्न हंतव्या मानवा दोषवर्जिताः ..
मंत्रसंरक्षितांगाश्च तथौषधिकृतादराः .. 32 ..
5.31.m: When you have come there, you must not kill human beings who are free from fault, / whose limbs are protected by mantras, and who respect medicinal herbs.

5.31.s:
camatkārapure kṣetre mayā dattā sthitiḥ sadā ..
pṛthivyāṃ kulamukhyānāṃ nāgānāṃ nāgasattamāḥ .. 33 ..
5.31.d:
चमत्कारपुरे क्षेत्रे मया दत्ता स्थितिः सदा ..
पृथिव्यां कुलमुख्यानां नागानां नागसत्तमाः .. 33 ..
5.31.m: O best of serpents, a perpetual residence has been granted by me / in the sacred field of Camatkārapura on earth for the chiefs of the serpent clans."

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktāśca te nāgā brahmaṇā satvaraṃ yayuḥ ..
pātālaṃ kulamukhyāśca tasminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ .. 34 ..
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ताश्च ते नागा ब्रह्मणा सत्वरं ययुः ..
पातालं कुलमुख्याश्च तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिताः .. 34 ..
5.31.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by Brahmā, those serpents quickly went / to Pātāla, while the chiefs of the clans settled in that sacred field.

5.31.s:
tatra śrāvaṇapaṃcamyāṃ yastānpūjayate naraḥ ..
sa prāpnoti naro'bhīṣṭaṃ teṣāmeva prasādataḥ .. 35 ..
5.31.d:
तत्र श्रावणपंचम्यां यस्तान्पूजयते नरः ..
स प्राप्नोति नरोऽभीष्टं तेषामेव प्रसादतः .. 35 ..
5.31.m: A person who worships them there on the fifth day of Śrāvaṇa / attains their desired object by their very grace.

5.31.s:
tasya vaṃśe'pi sarpāṇāṃ na bhayaṃ syānna kilbiṣam ..
na rogo nopasargaśca na ca bhūtabhayaṃ kvacit .. 36 ..
5.31.d:
तस्य वंशेऽपि सर्पाणां न भयं स्यान्न किल्बिषम् ..
न रोगो नोपसर्गश्च न च भूतभयं क्वचित् .. 36 ..
5.31.m: In that person's lineage, too, there will be no fear of serpents, nor sin, / nor disease, nor calamity, nor any fear of spirits anywhere.

5.31.s:
aputrastatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ karoti sutavāṃchayā ..
putraṃ viśiṣṭamāsādya pitṝṇāmanṛṇo hi saḥ .. 37 ..
5.31.d:
अपुत्रस्तत्र यः श्राद्धं करोति सुतवांछया ..
पुत्रं विशिष्टमासाद्य पितॄणामनृणो हि सः .. 37 ..
5.31.m: A childless person who performs a śrāddha there with a desire for a son, / having obtained an excellent son, becomes free from debt to the ancestors.

5.31.s:
tathā vaṃdhyā ca yā nārī paṃcamyāṃ bhāskarodaye ..
śrāvaṇe kurute snānaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
sā sadyo labhate putraṃ svavaṃśoddharaṇakṣamam .. 38 ..
5.31.d:
तथा वंध्या च या नारी पंचम्यां भास्करोदये ..
श्रावणे कुरुते स्नानं कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः ..
सा सद्यो लभते पुत्रं स्ववंशोद्धरणक्षमम् .. 38 ..
5.31.m: Likewise, a barren woman who takes a ritual ablution at sunrise on the fifth day / in the month of Śrāvaṇa, especially in the dark fortnight, / quickly obtains a son capable of uplifting her family,

5.31.s:
sarvarogavinirmuktaṃ surūpaṃ vinayānvitam ..
bhraṣṭarājyo naro yo vā tatra snānaṃ samācaret .. 39 ..
5.31.d:
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तं सुरूपं विनयान्वितम् ..
भ्रष्टराज्यो नरो यो वा तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 39 ..
5.31.m: free from all diseases, handsome, and endowed with modesty. / Or a man who has lost his kingdom who performs a ritual ablution there,

5.31.s:
tataḥ pūjayate nāgāñchrāvaṇe paṃcamīdine ..
sa hatvā'rigaṇā nsarvānbhūyorājyamavāpnuyāt .. 6.31.40 ..
5.31.d:
ततः पूजयते नागाञ्छ्रावणे पंचमीदिने ..
स हत्वाऽरिगणा न्सर्वान्भूयोराज्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 6.31.40 ..
5.31.m: and then worships the nāgas on the fifth day of Śrāvaṇa, / having slain all the hosts of his enemies, will regain his kingdom once more.

5.31.s:
yeṣāṃ mṛtyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ jāyate sarpabhakṣaṇāt ..
na teṣāṃ jāyate muktiḥ pretabhāvātkathaṃcana .. 41 ..
5.31.d:
येषां मृत्युर्मनुष्याणां जायते सर्पभक्षणात् ..
न तेषां जायते मुक्तिः प्रेतभावात्कथंचन .. 41 ..
5.31.m: For those men whose death occurs from being eaten [or bitten] by a serpent, / liberation from the state of a ghost does not occur in any way,

5.31.s:
yāvanna kriyate śrāddhaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe dvijottamāḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena mṛtasyāhipradaṃkṣaṇāt ..
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ prayatnena tasmiṃstīrthe'hisaṃbhave .. 42 ..
5.31.d:
यावन्न क्रियते श्राद्धं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन मृतस्याहिप्रदंक्षणात् ..
श्राद्धं कार्यं प्रयत्नेन तस्मिंस्तीर्थेऽहिसंभवे .. 42 ..
5.31.m: as long as a śrāddha is not performed at that sacred ford, O best of brahmins. / Therefore, with all effort, for one who has died from the bite of a serpent, / a śrāddha must diligently be performed at that sacred ford born of serpents.

5.31.s:
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi purāvṛttāṃ kathāṃ śubhām ..
indrasenasya rājarṣeḥ sarvapātakanāśinīm .. 43 ..
5.31.d:
अत्र वः कीर्तयिष्यामि पुरावृत्तां कथां शुभाम् ..
इन्द्रसेनस्य राजर्षेः सर्वपातकनाशिनीम् .. 43 ..
5.31.m: In this regard, I shall narrate to you an auspicious story of the past / concerning the royal seer Indrasena, which destroys all sins.

5.31.s:
indraseno mahīpālaḥ purāsīdripudarpahā ..
aśvamedhasahasreṇa iṣṭaṃ tena mahātmanā .. 44 ..
5.31.d:
इन्द्रसेनो महीपालः पुरासीद्रिपुदर्पहा ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रेण इष्टं तेन महात्मना .. 44 ..
5.31.m: Formerly, Indrasena was a king who destroyed the pride of his enemies; / a thousand horse sacrifices were offered by that great-souled one.

5.31.s:
tataḥ sa daivayogena prasuptaḥ śayane śubhe ..
daṣṭaḥ sarpeṇa muktaśca indraseno mahīpatiḥ ..
viyuktaścaiva sahasā jīvitavyena tatkṣaṇāt .. 45 ..
5.31.d:
ततः स दैवयोगेन प्रसुप्तः शयने शुभे ..
दष्टः सर्पेण मुक्तश्च इन्द्रसेनो महीपतिः ..
वियुक्तश्चैव सहसा जीवितव्येन तत्क्षणात् .. 45 ..
5.31.m: Then, by the turn of fate, as he was asleep on an auspicious couch, / King Indrasena was bitten by a serpent and abandoned [by it], / and at that very moment he was suddenly parted from his life.

5.31.s:
tatastasya suto'bhīṣṭastasyoddeśena kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
cakāra pretakāryāṇi smṛtyuktāni ca bhaktitaḥ .. .. 46 ..
5.31.d:
ततस्तस्य सुतोऽभीष्टस्तस्योद्देशेन कृत्स्नशः ..
चकार प्रेतकार्याणि स्मृत्युक्तानि च भक्तितः .. .. 46 ..
5.31.m: Then his beloved son, on his behalf, faithfully performed in full / all the rites for the departed prescribed by the legal treatises.

5.31.s:
gaṃgāyāmasthipātaṃ ca kṛtvā śrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa ..
gayāṃ gatvā tataścakre śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 47 ..
5.31.d:
गंगायामस्थिपातं च कृत्वा श्राद्धानि षोडश ..
गयां गत्वा ततश्चक्रे श्राद्धं श्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 47 ..
5.31.m: Having cast his bones into the Gaṅgā and performed the sixteen śrāddhas, / he then went to Gayā and performed the śrāddha endowed with faith.

5.31.s:
atha svapnāṃtare prāptaḥ pitā tasya sa bhūpatiḥ ..
provāca duḥkhitaḥ putraṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanam .. 48 ..
5.31.d:
अथ स्वप्नांतरे प्राप्तः पिता तस्य स भूपतिः ..
प्रोवाच दुःखितः पुत्रं बाष्पव्याकुललोचनम् .. 48 ..
5.31.m: Then, appearing in a dream, his father, that king, / grieving, with his eyes troubled by tears, spoke to his son:

5.31.s:
sarpamṛtyoḥ sakāśānme pretatvaṃ putra saṃsthitam ..
tena me bhavatā dattaṃ na kiñcidupatiṣṭhate .. 49 ..
5.31.d:
सर्पमृत्योः सकाशान्मे प्रेतत्वं पुत्र संस्थितम् ..
तेन मे भवता दत्तं न किञ्चिदुपतिष्ठते .. 49 ..
5.31.m: "Because of death from a serpent, my state as a ghost remains fixed, O son. / For that reason, nothing given by you reaches me.

5.31.s:
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ tasmāttvaṃ gaccha satvaram ..
tatra tīrthe kuru śrāddhaṃ sarpāṇāṃ matkṛte suta .. 6.31.50 ..
5.31.d:
चमत्कारपुरं क्षेत्रं तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ सत्वरम् ..
तत्र तीर्थे कुरु श्राद्धं सर्पाणां मत्कृते सुत .. 6.31.50 ..
5.31.m: "Therefore, go quickly to the sacred field of Camatkārapura. / In the sacred ford of the serpents there, perform the śrāddha for my sake, O son,

5.31.s:
yena saṃjāyate mokṣaḥ pretatvā ddāruṇānmama ..
sa tataḥ prātarutthāya tatsmṛtvā nṛpatervacaḥ .. 51 ..
5.31.d:
येन संजायते मोक्षः प्रेतत्वा द्दारुणान्मम ..
स ततः प्रातरुत्थाय तत्स्मृत्वा नृपतेर्वचः .. 51 ..
5.31.m: whereby my release from this terrible state of a ghost will come about." / Rising in the morning and recalling that speech of the king,

5.31.s:
pretarūpasya duḥkhārtastattīrthaṃ satvaraṃ gataḥ ..
cakāra ca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇe paṃca mīdine .. 52 ..
5.31.d:
प्रेतरूपस्य दुःखार्तस्तत्तीर्थं सत्वरं गतः ..
चकार च ततः श्राद्धं श्रावणे पंच मीदिने .. 52 ..
5.31.m: distressed on account of the one in the form of a ghost, he quickly went to that sacred ford, / and then performed the śrāddha on the fifth day of Śrāvaṇa.

5.31.s:
snātvā śraddhāsamopetaḥ saṃniveśya purodhasam ..
tataḥ sa darśanaṃ prāpto bhūyo'pi ca yathā purā .. 53 .. pre
5.31.d:
स्नात्वा श्रद्धासमोपेतः संनिवेश्य पुरोधसम् ..
ततः स दर्शनं प्राप्तो भूयोऽपि च यथा पुरा .. 53 .. प्रे
5.31.m: Having bathed, endowed with faith, having installed a priest, / he then received a vision once again just as before,

5.31.s:
tarūpeṇa duḥkhārto vākyametaduvāca ha ..
na mayā''sāditaṃ kiñcidyattvayā matkṛte kṛtam .. 54 ..
5.31.d:
तरूपेण दुःखार्तो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
न मया'ऽसादितं किञ्चिद्यत्त्वया मत्कृते कृतम् .. 54 ..
5.31.m: of [his father] in the form of a ghost, who, distressed, spoke these words: / "Nothing that you performed for my sake was obtained by me,

5.31.s:
phalaṃ śrāddhasya cātra tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu putraka ..
śrāddhārhā brāhmaṇāścātra camatkārapurodbhavāḥ .. 55 ..
5.31.d:
फलं श्राद्धस्य चात्र त्वं कारणं शृणु पुत्रक ..
श्राद्धार्हा ब्राह्मणाश्चात्र चमत्कारपुरोद्भवाः .. 55 ..
5.31.m: nor was any fruit of the śrāddha; and hear the reason for this, dear son: / the brahmins born in Camatkārapura are alone worthy of a śrāddha here.

5.31.s:
kṣetre'pi garhitāḥ śrāddhe ye'nyatra vyaṃgakādayaḥ ..
atra yatkriyate kiñciddānaṃ vā vratameva ca .. 56 ..
5.31.d:
क्षेत्रेऽपि गर्हिताः श्राद्धे येऽन्यत्र व्यंगकादयः ..
अत्र यत्क्रियते किञ्चिद्दानं वा व्रतमेव च .. 56 ..
5.31.m: Even those who are maimed and the like, who are elsewhere condemned at a śrāddha, [are worthy] in this sacred field. / Whatever gift or even observance is performed here,

5.31.s:
tathānyadapi viprārhaṃ karma yajñasamudbhavam..
tatteṣāṃ vacanātsarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ syādapi khaṃḍitam ..
parokṣe vāpi saṃpūrṇaṃ vṛthā saṃjāyate sphuṭam .. 57 ..
5.31.d:
तथान्यदपि विप्रार्हं कर्म यज्ञसमुद्भवम्..
तत्तेषां वचनात्सर्वं पूर्णं स्यादपि खंडितम् ..
परोक्षे वापि संपूर्णं वृथा संजायते स्फुटम् .. 57 ..
5.31.m: as well as any other rite worthy of brahmins born of sacrifice— / all that, even if deficient, becomes complete by their word; / or even if complete, in their absence it clearly becomes useless.

5.31.s:
tasmādasmātpurādviprānsamānīya tataḥ param ..
mama nāmnā kuru śrāddhaṃ yena muktiḥ prajāyate .. 58 ..
5.31.d:
तस्मादस्मात्पुराद्विप्रान्समानीय ततः परम् ..
मम नाम्ना कुरु श्राद्धं येन मुक्तिः प्रजायते .. 58 ..
5.31.m: Therefore, having brought brahmins from this city hereafter, / perform the śrāddha in my name, whereby liberation may be produced."

5.31.s:
athāsau prātarutthāya smaramāṇaḥ piturvacaḥ ..
duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ praviveśa purottame .. 59 ..
5.31.d:
अथासौ प्रातरुत्थाय स्मरमाणः पितुर्वचः ..
दुःखेन महताविष्टः प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमे .. 59 ..
5.31.m: Then, having risen in the morning, remembering his father's words, / overcome with great distress, he entered the excellent city.

5.31.s:
tataścānveṣayāmāsa śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇānnṛpaḥ ..
yatnato'pi na lebhe sa dhanāḍhyā brāhmaṇā yataḥ .. 6.31.60 ..
5.31.d:
ततश्चान्वेषयामास श्राद्धार्हान्ब्राह्मणान्नृपः ..
यत्नतोऽपि न लेभे स धनाढ्या ब्राह्मणा यतः .. 6.31.60 ..
5.31.m: Then the king sought out brahmins worthy of a śrāddha, / but even with effort he did not obtain [any], because the brahmins were wealthy.

5.31.s:
na tatra duḥkhitaḥ kaściddaridro'pi na duḥkhitaḥ ..
nākarmanirato vāpi pākhaṇḍanirato'thavā .. 61 ..
5.31.d:
न तत्र दुःखितः कश्चिद्दरिद्रोऽपि न दुःखितः ..
नाकर्मनिरतो वापि पाखण्डनिरतोऽथवा .. 61 ..
5.31.m: No one was distressed there, nor was even a poor man distressed, / nor was anyone devoted to inaction or devoted to heresy.

5.31.s:
sthānesthāne mahānādā utsavāśca gṛhegṛhe ..
vedavidyāvinodāśca smṛti vādāstathaiva ca .. 62 ..
5.31.d:
स्थानेस्थाने महानादा उत्सवाश्च गृहेगृहे ..
वेदविद्याविनोदाश्च स्मृति वादास्तथैव च .. 62 ..
5.31.m: In place after place were great shouts, and festivals in house after house, / pastimes of Vedic knowledge, and likewise discourses on the Smṛtis;

5.31.s:
śrūyaṃte yājñikānāṃ ca yajñakarmasamudbhavāḥ..
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ nṛṇām. ..
na mṛtyuḥ kasyacittatra pure brāhmaṇa sevite .. 63 ..
5.31.d:
श्रूयंते याज्ञिकानां च यज्ञकर्मसमुद्भवाः..
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्नाकालमरणं नृणाम्. ..
न मृत्युः कस्यचित्तत्र पुरे ब्राह्मण सेविते .. 63 ..
5.31.m: the sounds of sacrificers arising from sacrificial rites were heard. / There was no famine, no disease, no untimely death for men, / no death for anyone there in the city inhabited by brahmins.

5.31.s:
yathartuvarṣī parjanyaḥ sasyāni guṇavanti ca ..
bhūrikṣīrasravā gāvaḥ kṣīrāṇyājāvikāni ca .. 64 ..
5.31.d:
यथर्तुवर्षी पर्जन्यः सस्यानि गुणवन्ति च ..
भूरिक्षीरस्रवा गावः क्षीराण्याजाविकानि च .. 64 ..
5.31.m: The rain cloud rained according to season, and the crops were excellent; / cows yielded abundant milk, as did the milk of goats and sheep.

5.31.s:
yaṃyaṃ prārthayate vipraṃ sa śrāddhārthaṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
sa sa taṃ bhartsayāmāsa duruktaiḥ kopasaṃyutaḥ .. 65 ..
5.31.d:
यंयं प्रार्थयते विप्रं स श्राद्धार्थं महीपतिः ..
स स तं भर्त्सयामास दुरुक्तैः कोपसंयुतः .. 65 ..
5.31.m: Whichever brahmin the ruler of the earth begged for the sake of the śrāddha, / each one rebuked him with harsh words, filled with anger:

5.31.s:
dhigdhikpāpasamācāra kṣatriyāpasadātmaka ..
kiṃ kaścidbrāhmaṇo'śnāti pretaśrāddhe viśeṣataḥ .. 66 ..
5.31.d:
धिग्धिक्पापसमाचार क्षत्रियापसदात्मक ..
किं कश्चिद्ब्राह्मणोऽश्नाति प्रेतश्राद्धे विशेषतः .. 66 ..
5.31.m: "Fie, fie, O base kṣatriya of sinful conduct! / Does any brahmin eat at a ghost-śrāddha, especially?

5.31.s:
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ yāvanna kaścicchapate dvijaḥ ..
nihanti vā prakopena svargamārganirodhakam .. 67 ..
5.31.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं यावन्न कश्चिच्छपते द्विजः ..
निहन्ति वा प्रकोपेन स्वर्गमार्गनिरोधकम् .. 67 ..
5.31.m: Therefore go quickly, before some twice-born curses you, / or in anger slays you who obstruct the path to heaven!"

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sa duḥkhito rājā niścakrāma bhayārditaḥ ..
camatkārapurāttasmādvailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 68 ..
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः स दुःखितो राजा निश्चक्राम भयार्दितः ..
चमत्कारपुरात्तस्माद्वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः .. 68 ..
5.31.m: Sūta said: / Then that king, distressed and afflicted with fear, / went out from that Camatkārapura, having fallen into the deepest embarrassment.

5.31.s:
cintayāmāsa rājeṃdra smṛtvāvasthāṃ pituśca tām ..
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ me syātpiturgatiḥ .. 69 ..
5.31.d:
चिन्तयामास राजेंद्र स्मृत्वावस्थां पितुश्च ताम् ..
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं मे स्यात्पितुर्गतिः .. 69 ..
5.31.m: He pondered, O best of kings, recalling that condition of his father: / "What shall I do? Where shall I go? How can my father attain [a good] state?"

5.31.s:
tataḥ sa sacivānsarvānpreṣayitvā gṛhaṃ prati ..
ekākī bhikṣurūpeṇa sthitastatraiva satpure ..6.31.70...
5.31.d:
ततः स सचिवान्सर्वान्प्रेषयित्वा गृहं प्रति ..
एकाकी भिक्षुरूपेण स्थितस्तत्रैव सत्पुरे ..6.31.70...
5.31.m: Then, having sent all his ministers toward home, / alone, in the guise of a beggar, he remained right there in that virtuous city.

5.31.s:
sa jñātvā nagare tatra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam ..
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ madhye dākṣiṇyabhājanam .. 71 ..
5.31.d:
स ज्ञात्वा नगरे तत्र ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ..
सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां मध्ये दाक्षिण्यभाजनम् .. 71 ..
5.31.m: Having learned in that city of a brahmin of praised vows, / an object of courtesy among all the lords of brahmins,

5.31.s:
devaśarmābhidhānaṃ tu śaraṇāgatavatsalam ..
āhitāgniṃ caturvedaṃ smṛtimārgānuyāyinam .. 72 ..
5.31.d:
देवशर्माभिधानं तु शरणागतवत्सलम् ..
आहिताग्निं चतुर्वेदं स्मृतिमार्गानुयायिनम् .. 72 ..
5.31.m: named Devaśarman, affectionate to those who seek refuge, / one who maintained the sacred fires, learned in the four Vedas, following the path of the Smṛti,

5.31.s:
tatastu prātarutthāya kṛtvāṃtyajamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
śodhayāmāsa kṛcchreṇa malotsarganiketanam .. 73 .. .
5.31.d:
ततस्तु प्रातरुत्थाय कृत्वांत्यजमयं वपुः ..
शोधयामास कृच्छ्रेण मलोत्सर्गनिकेतनम् .. 73 .. .
5.31.m: he then rose in the morning, assumed the appearance of an outcaste, / and with difficulty cleaned the privy.

5.31.s:
atha yaḥ kurute karma tatra viṣṭhāpraśodhanam ..
so'bhyetya tamuvācedaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ .. 74 ..
5.31.d:
अथ यः कुरुते कर्म तत्र विष्ठाप्रशोधनम् ..
सोऽभ्येत्य तमुवाचेदं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः .. 74 ..
5.31.m: Now he who usually performed the work of cleaning the feces there, / having approached, said this to him, his eyes red with anger:

5.31.s:
kutastvamiha saṃprāpto madvṛtterupaghātakṛt ..
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ no cennayiṣye yamasādanam .. 75 ..
5.31.d:
कुतस्त्वमिह संप्राप्तो मद्वृत्तेरुपघातकृत् ..
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं नो चेन्नयिष्ये यमसादनम् .. 75 ..
5.31.m: "Whence have you arrived here, causing harm to my livelihood? / Therefore go quickly, otherwise I will take you to the abode of Yama!"

5.31.s:
tasyaivaṃ vadato'pyāśu balātsa pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
śodhayāmāsa tatsthānaṃ devaśarmasamudbhavam .. 76 ..
5.31.d:
तस्यैवं वदतोऽप्याशु बलात्स पृथिवीपतिः ..
शोधयामास तत्स्थानं देवशर्मसमुद्भवम् .. 76 ..
5.31.m: Even while he was speaking thus, that ruler of the earth forcibly / cleaned that place belonging to Devaśarman quickly.

5.31.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte caṃḍālena dvijottamāḥ ..
sa prokta ucite kāle praṇipatya ca dūrataḥ .. 77 ..
5.31.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते चंडालेन द्विजोत्तमाः ..
स प्रोक्त उचिते काले प्रणिपत्य च दूरतः .. 77 ..
5.31.m: Then, at the end of a year, O best of the twice-born, / at the appropriate time, having bowed down from afar, that caṇḍāla said:

5.31.s:
svāmiṃstava kulepyevaṃ gūthāśodhanakarmakṛt ..
tadasmākaṃ na cānyasya tatkimanyaḥ praveśitaḥ .. 78 ..
5.31.d:
स्वामिंस्तव कुलेप्येवं गूथाशोधनकर्मकृत् ..
तदस्माकं न चान्यस्य तत्किमन्यः प्रवेशितः .. 78 ..
5.31.m: "Master, in your household as well, the duty of cleaning feces / belongs to us and not to another; why then has another been let in?"

5.31.s:
atha śrutvā ca tadvākyaṃ sa prāha dvijasattamaḥ ..
na mayā kaścidanyo'tra nirdiṣṭo gopyakarmaṇi..
adhikārastvayātmīyastathā kāryo yathā purā .. 79 ..
5.31.d:
अथ श्रुत्वा च तद्वाक्यं स प्राह द्विजसत्तमः ..
न मया कश्चिदन्योऽत्र निर्दिष्टो गोप्यकर्मणि..
अधिकारस्त्वयात्मीयस्तथा कार्यो यथा पुरा .. 79 ..
5.31.m: Then, hearing that statement, that best of the twice-born said: / "No one else has been designated by me for this secret work; / you should carry out your own duty just as before."

5.31.s:
tadānyadivase prāpte soṃ'tyajaḥ kopasaṃyutaḥ ..
śastramādāya saṃprāpto vadhārthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ ..6.31.80..
5.31.d:
तदान्यदिवसे प्राप्ते सोंऽत्यजः कोपसंयुतः ..
शस्त्रमादाय संप्राप्तो वधार्थं तस्य भूपतेः ..6.31.80..
5.31.m: Then, when another day arrived, that outcaste, filled with anger, / came taking up a weapon to kill that ruler of the earth.

5.31.s:
śastrodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prahārekṛtaniścayam ..
tatastaṃ līlayā bhūyo muṣṭinā mūrdhnyatāḍayat .. 81 ..
5.31.d:
शस्त्रोद्यतकरं दृष्ट्वा प्रहारेकृतनिश्चयम् ..
ततस्तं लीलया भूयो मुष्टिना मूर्ध्न्यताडयत् .. 81 ..
5.31.m: Seeing his hand raised with a weapon, determined upon a blow, / [the king] then effortlessly struck him on the head with his fist.

5.31.s:
tatastasya viniṣkrāṃte locane tatkṣaṇāddvijāḥ ..
susrāva rudhiraṃ paścātpapāta gatajīvitaḥ .. 82 ..
5.31.d:
ततस्तस्य विनिष्क्रांते लोचने तत्क्षणाद्द्विजाः ..
सुस्राव रुधिरं पश्चात्पपात गतजीवितः .. 82 ..
5.31.m: Then his eyes popped out instantly, O twice-born; / blood flowed forth, and then he fell down dead.

5.31.s:
taṃ śrutvā nihataṃ tena caṃḍālaṃ nijakiṃkaram ..
devaśarmātikopena tadvadhārthamupāgataḥ .. 83 ..
5.31.d:
तं श्रुत्वा निहतं तेन चंडालं निजकिंकरम् ..
देवशर्मातिकोपेन तद्वधार्थमुपागतः .. 83 ..
5.31.m: Hearing that that caṇḍāla, his own servant, had been killed by him, / Devaśarman approached in intense anger to kill him.

5.31.s:
tataḥ putraiśca pautraiśca sahito'nyaiśca bandhubhiḥ ..
loṣṭaistaṃ tāḍayāmāsa bhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ .. 84 ..
5.31.d:
ततः पुत्रैश्च पौत्रैश्च सहितोऽन्यैश्च बन्धुभिः ..
लोष्टैस्तं ताडयामास भर्त्समानो मुहुर्मुहुः .. 84 ..
5.31.m: Then, accompanied by his sons, grandsons, and other kinsmen, / he repeatedly struck him with clods of earth while rebuking him.

5.31.s:
so'pi saṃtāḍyamānastu prahārairjarjarīkṛtaḥ ..
vedoccāraṃ tataścakre darśayitvopavītakam .. 85 ..
5.31.d:
सोऽपि संताड्यमानस्तु प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतः ..
वेदोच्चारं ततश्चक्रे दर्शयित्वोपवीतकम् .. 85 ..
5.31.m: Though he was being beaten and battered with blows, / he then chanted the Veda, showing his sacred thread.

5.31.s:
atha te vismitāḥ sarve devaśarmapuraḥsarāḥ ..
brāhmaṇāstaṃ samudvīkṣya vedoccāraparāyaṇam .. 86 ..
5.31.d:
अथ ते विस्मिताः सर्वे देवशर्मपुरःसराः ..
ब्राह्मणास्तं समुद्वीक्ष्य वेदोच्चारपरायणम् .. 86 ..
5.31.m: Then all those brahmins, led by Devaśarman, were astonished / upon seeing him intent on chanting the Veda.

5.31.s:
pṛṣṭaśca kimidaṃ karma tavāṃtyajajanocitam ..
eṣā vedātmikā vāṇī spaṣṭākṣarakalasvanā ..
tatkiṃ śāpaparibhraṣṭastvaṃ kaścidbrāhmaṇottamaḥ .. 87 ..
5.31.d:
पृष्टश्च किमिदं कर्म तवांत्यजजनोचितम् ..
एषा वेदात्मिका वाणी स्पष्टाक्षरकलस्वना ..
तत्किं शापपरिभ्रष्टस्त्वं कश्चिद्ब्राह्मणोत्तमः .. 87 ..
5.31.m: And he was questioned: "What is this deed of yours, fit for an outcaste person? / This Vedic speech has a sweet sound of distinct syllables; / are you perhaps some excellent brahmin fallen due to a curse,

5.31.s:
yenaivaṃ kuruṣe karma garhitaṃ cāṃtyajairapi ..
tataḥ sa prahasannāha kṣatriyo'haṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
viṣṇusena iti khyāto haihayānvayasaṃbhavaḥ .. 88 ..
5.31.d:
येनैवं कुरुषे कर्म गर्हितं चांत्यजैरपि ..
ततः स प्रहसन्नाह क्षत्रियोऽहं महीपतिः ..
विष्णुसेन इति ख्यातो हैहयान्वयसंभवः .. 88 ..
5.31.m: by which you perform a deed despised even by outcastes?" / Then, laughing, he said: "I am a kṣatriya, a ruler of the earth, / renowned as Viṣṇusena, born of the lineage of the Haihayas.

5.31.s:
sohamārādhanārthāya tvasminsthāna upāgataḥ..
adya saṃvatsaro jātaḥ karmaṇyasminratasya ca..89..
5.31.d:
सोहमाराधनार्थाय त्वस्मिन्स्थान उपागतः..
अद्य संवत्सरो जातः कर्मण्यस्मिन्रतस्य च..89..
5.31.m: I arrived at this place for the sake of propitiating you; / today a year has passed while I have been engaged in this work."

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa vipraḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tamuvāca mahīpatim..6.31.90..
kiṃ tatkṛtyaṃ samuddiśya tvayaitatkarma garhitam ..
kṛtaṃ kīrtaya yenāśu tavābhīṣṭaṃ karomyaham ..9...
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स विप्रः कृपयान्वितः ..
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा तमुवाच महीपतिम्..6.31.90..
किं तत्कृत्यं समुद्दिश्य त्वयैतत्कर्म गर्हितम् ..
कृतं कीर्तय येनाशु तवाभीष्टं करोम्यहम् ..9...
5.31.m:
Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, that brahmin, filled with compassion, / folded his hands in reverence and addressed that ruler of the earth:
"With what purpose in mind was this censured deed done by you? / Declare it, so that I may swiftly fulfill your desire.

5.31.s:
nāsti me kiñcidaprāptaṃ tathā'sādhyaṃ mahīpate ..
tasmāttava kariṣyāmi kṛtyaṃ yadyapi durlabham .. 92 ..
5.31.d:
नास्ति मे किञ्चिदप्राप्तं तथाऽसाध्यं महीपते ..
तस्मात्तव करिष्यामि कृत्यं यद्यपि दुर्लभम् .. 92 ..
5.31.m: There is nothing unattained by me, nor anything impossible, O lord of the earth; / therefore I shall accomplish your task, even though it may be hard to achieve."

5.31.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
pitā mamāhinā daṣṭaḥ pretatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ..
so'tra nāgahrade śrāddhe kṛte muktimavāpnuyāt .. 93 ..
5.31.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
पिता ममाहिना दष्टः प्रेतत्वं समुपागतः ..
सोऽत्र नागह्रदे श्राद्धे कृते मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 93 ..
5.31.m: The king said: / "My father was bitten by a serpent and has attained the state of a ghost. / If a śrāddha is performed here at Nāgahrada, he will attain liberation.

5.31.s:
tasmāttattāraṇārthāya viprakṛtyaṃ samācara ..
etadarthaṃ mayaitatte kṛtaṃ karma vigarhitam .. 94 .. ..
5.31.d:
तस्मात्तत्तारणार्थाय विप्रकृत्यं समाचर ..
एतदर्थं मयैतत्ते कृतं कर्म विगर्हितम् .. 94 .. ..
5.31.m: Therefore, perform the duty of a brahmin for his rescue. / For this purpose was this censured deed done by me toward you."

5.31.s:
.. devaśarmovāca .. ..
evaṃ kuru nṛpaśreṣṭha śrāddhe'haṃ te pituḥ svayam ..
brāhmaṇaḥ saṃbhaviṣyāmi tasmācchrāddhaṃ samācara .. 95 ..
5.31.d:
.. देवशर्मोवाच .. ..
एवं कुरु नृपश्रेष्ठ श्राद्धेऽहं ते पितुः स्वयम् ..
ब्राह्मणः संभविष्यामि तस्माच्छ्राद्धं समाचर .. 95 ..
5.31.m: Devaśarman said: / "Do so, O best of kings! In your father's śrāddha I myself / will be the brahmin; therefore, perform the śrāddha."

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha te suhṛdastasya putrāḥ pautrāśca bāṃdhavāḥ ..
procurnaitatprayuktaṃ te śrāddhaṃ bhoktuṃ vigarhitam .. 96 ..
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ ते सुहृदस्तस्य पुत्राः पौत्राश्च बांधवाः ..
प्रोचुर्नैतत्प्रयुक्तं ते श्राद्धं भोक्तुं विगर्हितम् .. 96 ..
5.31.m: Sūta said: / Then his friends, sons, grandsons, and relatives / said, "It is not proper for you to eat of a censured śrāddha.

5.31.s:
tasmādyadi bhavānasya śrāddhe bhoktā tataḥ svayam ..
sarve bhavantaṃ tyakṣāmastathānye'pi dvijottamāḥ .. 97 ..
5.31.d:
तस्माद्यदि भवानस्य श्राद्धे भोक्ता ततः स्वयम् ..
सर्वे भवन्तं त्यक्षामस्तथान्येऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 97 ..
5.31.m: Therefore, if you partake [of food] in his śrāddha yourself, / we all, as well as the other best of the twice-born, will abandon you."

5.31.s:
.. devaśarmovāca .. ..
kāmaṃ tyajata māṃ sarve yūyamanye'pi ye dvijāḥ ..
mayaivāsya pratijñātaṃ bhoktuṃ śrāddhe mahīpateḥ .. 98 ..
5.31.d:
.. देवशर्मोवाच .. ..
कामं त्यजत मां सर्वे यूयमन्येऽपि ये द्विजाः ..
मयैवास्य प्रतिज्ञातं भोक्तुं श्राद्धे महीपतेः .. 98 ..
5.31.m: Devaśarman said: / "Abandon me as you will, all of you, and whichever other twice-born [wish to]! / I have already promised this lord of the earth to eat in his śrāddha."

5.31.s:
evamuktvā sa vipreṃdrastenaiva sahitastadā ..
nāgahradaṃ samāsādya śrāddhe vai bhuktavānatha .. 99 ..
5.31.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रेंद्रस्तेनैव सहितस्तदा ..
नागह्रदं समासाद्य श्राद्धे वै भुक्तवानथ .. 99 ..
5.31.m: Having spoken thus, that best of brahmins, accompanied by him, / then went to Nāgahrada and indeed ate in the śrāddha.

5.31.s:
bhuktamātre tatastasminvāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
nādayaṃtī jagatsarvaṃ harṣayaṃtī mahīpatim .. 6.31.100 ..
5.31.d:
भुक्तमात्रे ततस्तस्मिन्वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
नादयंती जगत्सर्वं हर्षयंती महीपतिम् .. 6.31.100 ..
5.31.m: As soon as he had eaten, a bodiless voice spoke, / resounding through the entire world and gladdening the lord of the earth:

5.31.s:
pretabhāvādvinirmuktaḥ putrāhaṃ tvatprabhāvataḥ ..
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridivālayam .. 101 ..
5.31.d:
प्रेतभावाद्विनिर्मुक्तः पुत्राहं त्वत्प्रभावतः ..
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि सांप्रतं त्रिदिवालयम् .. 101 ..
5.31.m: "O son, I have been freed from the state of a ghost by your power! / May you have well-being; I shall now go to the abode of the heavens."

5.31.s:
tatkṛtvā nṛpatirhṛṣṭastaṃ praṇamya dvijottamam ..
provāca kuru me vākyaṃ yadbravīmi dvijottama .. 102 ..
5.31.d:
तत्कृत्वा नृपतिर्हृष्टस्तं प्रणम्य द्विजोत्तमम् ..
प्रोवाच कुरु मे वाक्यं यद्ब्रवीमि द्विजोत्तम .. 102 ..
5.31.m: Having accomplished that, the delighted king bowed to that best of the twice-born / and said: "Grant my word which I speak, O best of the twice-born!

5.31.s:
asti māhiṣmatīnāma nagarī narmadātaṭe ..
sā cāsmākaṃ rājadhānī pitṛparyāgatā vibho .. 103 ..
5.31.d:
अस्ति माहिष्मतीनाम नगरी नर्मदातटे ..
सा चास्माकं राजधानी पितृपर्यागता विभो .. 103 ..
5.31.m: There is a city named Māhiṣmatī on the bank of the Narmadā; / that is our capital, inherited from my ancestors, O powerful one.

5.31.s:
ahaṃ yacchāmi te brahmansamastaviṣayānvitām..
mayā bhṛtyena tatrasthaḥ kuru rājyamakaṃṭakam .. 104 ..
.. devaśarmovāca .. ..
na caitadyujyate vaktuṃ na vipro rājyamarhati ..
tasmādgaccha nijaṃ rājyaṃ paripālaya pārthiva ....5..
5.31.d:
अहं यच्छामि ते ब्रह्मन्समस्तविषयान्विताम्..
मया भृत्येन तत्रस्थः कुरु राज्यमकंटकम् .. 104 ..
.. देवशर्मोवाच .. ..
न चैतद्युज्यते वक्तुं न विप्रो राज्यमर्हति ..
तस्माद्गच्छ निजं राज्यं परिपालय पार्थिव ....5..
5.31.m:
I give it to you, O brahmin, along with all its territories. / Staying there, with me as your servant, rule the kingdom without rivals!"
Devaśarman said: / "It is not fit to say this; a brahmin is not entitled to a kingdom. / Therefore go to your own kingdom and protect it, O king!"

5.31.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ visarjitastena jagāma sa mahāpatiḥ ..
svaṃ deśaṃ harṣasaṃyuktaḥ kṛtakṛtyo dvijottamāḥ .. .. 106 ..
5.31.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं विसर्जितस्तेन जगाम स महापतिः ..
स्वं देशं हर्षसंयुक्तः कृतकृत्यो द्विजोत्तमाः .. .. 106 ..
5.31.m: Sūta said: / Thus dismissed by him, that great lord went / to his own land, filled with joy, having accomplished his task, O best of the twice-born.

5.31.s:
so'pi sarvaiḥ parityakto brāhmaṇaiḥ puravāsibhiḥ ..
devaśarmā samuddiśya doṣaṃ śrāddhasamudbhavam .. 107 ..
5.31.d:
सोऽपि सर्वैः परित्यक्तो ब्राह्मणैः पुरवासिभिः ..
देवशर्मा समुद्दिश्य दोषं श्राद्धसमुद्भवम् .. 107 ..
5.31.m: He too was abandoned by all the brahmins residing in the city, / Devaśarman, on account of the fault arising from the śrāddha.

5.31.s:
tato nāgahrade tasminsa kṛtvā nijamandiram ..
nivāsamakarottatra svādhyāyanirataḥ śuciḥ .. 108 ..
5.31.d:
ततो नागह्रदे तस्मिन्स कृत्वा निजमन्दिरम् ..
निवासमकरोत्तत्र स्वाध्यायनिरतः शुचिः .. 108 ..
5.31.m: Then, having built his own dwelling at that Nāgahrada, / he took up residence there, devoted to Vedic recitation and pure.

5.31.s:
tatrasthasya nirastasya ye putrāḥ syurdvijottamāḥ ..
teṣāṃ saṃtatayo 'dyāpi te proktā bāhyavāsinaḥ .. 109 ..
5.31.d:
तत्रस्थस्य निरस्तस्य ये पुत्राः स्युर्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तेषां संततयो ऽद्यापि ते प्रोक्ता बाह्यवासिनः .. 109 ..
5.31.m: The sons born to him, rejected while living there, O best of the twice-born— / their lineages even today are called the 'dwellers outside'.

5.31.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ nāgatīrthasamudbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 6.31.110 ..
5.31.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं नागतीर्थसमुद्भवम् ..
माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 6.31.110 ..
5.31.m: All this has been recounted to you regarding the origin of the Nāgatīrtha, / a māhātmya destroying all sins, O best of brahmins.

5.31.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..
śṛṇuyādvā na vaṃśe'pi tasya syātsārpajaṃ bhayam .. 111 ..
5.31.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते भक्त्या संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..
शृणुयाद्वा न वंशेऽपि तस्य स्यात्सार्पजं भयम् .. 111 ..
5.31.m: Whoever recites or hears this with devotion when the fifth day arrives, / even in his lineage there shall be no fear arising from snakes.

5.31.s:
tathā vimucyate pāpādbhakṣajātānna saṃśayaḥ ..
kṛtādajñānato viprāḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 112 ..
5.31.d:
तथा विमुच्यते पापाद्भक्षजातान्न संशयः ..
कृतादज्ञानतो विप्राः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 112 ..
5.31.m: Likewise he is freed without doubt from the sin arising from food / eaten through ignorance, O brahmins; this is truth spoken by me.

5.31.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāgatīrthamanuttamam ..
māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ vā śrotavyaṃ vā samāhitaiḥ .. 113 ..
5.31.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन नागतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
माहात्म्यं पठनीयं वा श्रोतव्यं वा समाहितैः .. 113 ..
5.31.m: Therefore with all effort the unsurpassed māhātmya of the Nāgatīrtha / is to be recited or heard by the concentrated.

5.31.s:
śrāddhakāle tu saṃprāpte yaścaitatpaṭhate dvijaḥ ..
sa prāpnoti phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gayāśrāddhasamudbhavam .. 114 ..
5.31.d:
श्राद्धकाले तु संप्राप्ते यश्चैतत्पठते द्विजः ..
स प्राप्नोति फलं कृत्स्नं गयाश्राद्धसमुद्भवम् .. 114 ..
5.31.m: And when the time of śrāddha arrives, which twice-born recites this, / he attains the entire fruit arising from a śrāddha at Gayā.

5.31.s:
tathā ye kīrtitā doṣāḥ śrāddhe dravyasamudbhavāḥ ..
vratavaiklavyajāścāpi tathā brāhmaṇasaṃbhavāḥ .. 115 ..
5.31.d:
तथा ये कीर्तिता दोषाः श्राद्धे द्रव्यसमुद्भवाः ..
व्रतवैक्लव्यजाश्चापि तथा ब्राह्मणसंभवाः .. 115 ..
5.31.m: Likewise, whichever faults are proclaimed in a śrāddha arising from materials, / or arising from lapses in observances, as well as those arising from brahmins,

5.31.s:
te sarve nāśamāyāṃti kīrtyamāne samāhitaiḥ ..
nāgahradasya māhātmye śrāddhakāla upasthite .. 116 ..
5.31.d:
ते सर्वे नाशमायांति कीर्त्यमाने समाहितैः ..
नागह्रदस्य माहात्म्ये श्राद्धकाल उपस्थिते .. 116 ..
5.31.m: they all perish when the māhātmya of Nāgahrada / is recited by the concentrated as the time of śrāddha arrives.

5.31.s:
tathā vinihatā gobhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ śvāpadairapi ..
etasminpaṭhite śrāddhe gacchaṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 117 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgahradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 31 .. .. cha .. ..
5.31.d:
तथा विनिहता गोभिर्ब्राह्मणैः श्वापदैरपि ..
एतस्मिन्पठिते श्राद्धे गच्छंति परमां गतिम् .. 117 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागह्रदमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 31 .. .. छ .. ..
5.31.m:
Likewise, those slain by cows, brahmins, and wild beasts, / when this is recited during a śrāddha, go to the highest state."
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgahrada', in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
